2026_02_IND_KC.headline: Colts defense gets no soft landing against Kansas City
2026_02_IND_KC.paragraph1: Indianapolis heads to Kansas City after a difficult defensive opener in which the Colts allowed Baltimore to move the ball efficiently and left coordinator Lou Anarumo with clear correction points. Kansas City, meanwhile, opens with back-to-back prime-time home games and brings the Colts into Arrowhead for Sunday night. Indianapolis must generate disruption without losing structure against Patrick Mahomes, while the Chiefs can stress a defense still sorting through its first-week issues by forcing it to defend every level of the field.
2026_02_IND_KC.model_rationale: Kansas City’s ability to stress Indianapolis across the field determines whether the Chiefs can keep Patrick Mahomes comfortable while the Colts search for more defensive disruption.
